purpose.value: The website positions this product for conditioning and finishing hair and beard.
purpose.note: Positioning only; not an approved efficacy claim.

ingredients.value: Sea buckthorn CO2, marula oil, rosehip fruit oil, tamanu seed oil, argan kernel oil, broccoli seed oil, jojoba seed oil, avocado oil, sunflower seed oil, sweet almond oil, tocopherol, fragrance (Santal Noir).

directions.value: Warm 2–4 drops between palms and work through damp or dry hair and beard. Style as usual. Use morning or night, or both.
